prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you have any preferences I should use when picking one? For example:
- Your ZIP code or part of Pleasanton (downtown, near Stoneridge, west side)
- Whether you need a dentist who takes your insurance (and which plan)
- Adult vs pediatric, preferred gender/language, or need for a gentle/hygienist-focused office
- Any time constraints (weekend/evening availability)

If you don’t have preferences, I can give general tips for finding the “best” dentist for a checkup and cleaning and then pull together a short list of highly rated practices in Pleasanton for you to choose from. Which would you prefer?
